svg.aria-label: Real trained 3D MNIST embeddings, seed 42. APML alone yields a distance ratio 0.7824; APML plus MES yields 0.99998. Fixed camera and axes, projected to a 2D page.
svg.text: From class discrimination to geometric regularity
Real 3D MNIST embeddings · digits 1–4 · seed 42 · 10 training epochs · MES weight β = 1
Dots: 55 measured TEST embeddings per class, fixed subsample · Diamonds: trained class proxies · Same camera and scale
3D coordinates shown through a fixed orthographic camera projection (azimuth −59°, elevation 19°); not a 2D embedding model
